description: Source code for the EffectHapticGenerator component of the Android audio effects, implementing a haptic generator effect with processing chain, parameters, and effect API functions.

classes.name: HapticGeneratorContext
classes.description: Haptic generator effect context holding configuration, processing chain, parameters, and state.

classes.name: HapticGeneratorParam
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for the haptic generator effect.

classes.name: HapticGeneratorProcessorsRecord
classes.description: Structure to keep shared pointers to processing components like filters, envelopes, and distortions.

classes.name: HapticBiquadFilter
classes.description: Class representing a biquad filter used in processing chain.

classes.name: SlowEnvelope
classes.description: Class for envelope processing, used for normalization.

classes.name: Distortion
classes.description: Class for applying distortion effects in processing chain.

classes.name: Ramp
classes.description: Class for ramp processing, used as half-wave rectifier.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_Init
methods.description: Initializes the haptic generator context with default parameters and configuration.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_buildProcessingChain
methods.description: Builds the processing chain with filters, envelopes, and distortions based on parameters.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_Configure
methods.description: Configures the effect with given audio effect configuration.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_SetParameter
methods.description: Sets parameters such as haptic intensity and vibrator info.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_runProcessingChain
methods.description: Runs the processing chain to generate haptic data from audio input.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_Dump
methods.description: Outputs current parameters and settings for debugging.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_Process
methods.description: Processes audio buffers to generate haptic feedback data.

methods.name: HapticGenerator_Command
methods.description: Handles control commands for the effect, such as init, set config, reset, enable, disable, set param.
